recommendations.name: Total-sum normalize -> log2 -> z-score
recommendations.reason: Sample totals differ substantially and values are non-negative/skewed.
assumptions: Non-negative signal; total signal is comparable across samples.

recommendations.name: Median-scale -> log2
recommendations.reason: Robust alternative to total-sum when a few features dominate totals.
assumptions: Most features are not differentially abundant.

recommendations.name: log2(x + 1) -> z-score
recommendations.reason: Strong right skew with non-negative values.
assumptions: Non-negative values; a small pseudocount is acceptable.

recommendations.name: arcsinh (intensity-like) -> z-score
recommendations.reason: Intensity-like skewed data; arcsinh handles zeros without a pseudocount.

recommendations.name: Internal-standard normalization (if you have IS features/columns)
recommendations.reason: Normalize each sample to spiked internal-standard features (you select them).
assumptions: Internal standards are stable across samples.
warnings: Requires you to identify the internal-standard features/columns.

recommendations.name: Quantile normalization (forces identical distributions)
recommendations.reason: Aggressively removes distribution differences between samples.
assumptions: Global distribution shifts are technical, not biological.
warnings: Inappropriate when distribution shifts are biologically real.
